items.markdown:
Product recommendations are `personalized suggestions shown to shoppers based on browsing behavior, purchase history, and real-time context to improve discovery and increase order value`.

### Common Recommendation Types

- **Similar items:** Alternatives to the product a shopper currently views.
- **Frequently bought together:** Complementary add-ons or bundles paired with the current item.
- **Best sellers & trending:** Popular products overall or within a specific category.
- **Behavior-based & dynamic:** Real-time suggestions driven by search queries, cart contents, or past orders.

### High-Impact Placements & Tactics

- **On-site carousels & quizzes:** Show curated collections on product pages, use guided quizzes to match shoppers to items, or offer add-to-cart upsells—see [ConvertFlow](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF18U4mR9PfmmXJlr3Z1kT_vZNdcWj8WkvDkicwOPgm6H6SV5I91diGlzHQMjTXm29yrdPHemyT0jKFRqFEsPW_bMaOIWISyL52dkjgxuHOnlDS2BkeTqpkhagNA4X9BhofiKJcr4s7_bHIwh6oP62ZxVsMdhCDccjcbOvsFZ-_I_knaYT2TUdWw) for templates and examples.
- **Popups & email follow-ups:** Use exit-intent prompts, cart-recovery reminders, and post-purchase emails to suggest relevant items—explore tactics on [Drip](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXv-XX5tEQ_Hv-XKI8UKvxRD5Ll5kCBJz7WhORrOBNIqdR7VRF85iymzqApgwoTN8eZ4KaN5s9Qs6Nv-_2rMZkTzWkD83_p3J7wao-05Zj8V_kHfQFMQkHuYgrfsu9pS40bIsYLR9KRDYj).
- **Submitting ideas to companies:** If you are sharing unsolicited product suggestions with a brand as part of a job search, most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqAEBxCJF18Z3Xm93mLXJqc0IiMIcdDRibNIqvyQR4nQFKrwSyxAt72VhkGoHlvp6fRrEe0z7PVQFLKhnAJDXI539h3HMswt1GWnouZ28oCvCP8j9TLrLGXS5Xm6-FX7oVu9Pml3vkaBAvZudeUF7rNFb3C-M0OmorbZf2whVgoJ7rfrZy5ymrn8YCBzuErgfr_vVfw5SJ_QPPLimnGjJnbAhqhhPJjKnYa8) agree it is often ineffective due to company intellectual property and legal policies.
